errors.text_span: Общият брой на включените сектори е шест.
errors.evidence: The chart shows seven sectors, not six. The percentages are 5%, 13%, 20%, 17%, 16%, 15%, and 14%.

errors.text_span: Секторът, обозначен като „14-17“, е син и представлява 14% от общата сума.
errors.evidence: The sector for the age group "14-17" corresponds to the slice with 5%, not 14%. The 14% slice corresponds to the "65+" age group.

errors.text_span: Секторът „18-24“ е оранжев и представлява 5% от общата сума.
errors.evidence: The sector for the age group "18-24" is orange, but it represents 13%, not 5%.
The sector for the age group "25-34" is grey, but it represents 20%, not 13%.

errors.text_span: Секторът „45-54“ е зелен и представлява 15% от общата сума.
errors.evidence: The sector for the age group "45-54" is light blue and represents 16%. The green sector representing 15% corresponds to the "55-64" age group.

errors.text_span: Секторът „55-64“ е светло сив и представлява 20%
errors.evidence: The sector for the age group "55-64" is green and represents 15%. The grey sector representing 20% corresponds to the "25-34" age group.
The sector for the age group "65+" is dark blue and represents 14%. The 16% slice corresponds to the "45-54" age group, and its color is not black.

errors.text_span: Секторите изглеждат сортирани по низходящ размер, започвайки от светло сив и продължавайки по посока на часовниковата стрелка.
errors.evidence: The sectors are not sorted by size. The values clockwise from the 5% slice are: 5, 13, 20, 17, 16, 15, 14, which is not a descending order.
